_comment: Ad-hoc/amateur teams that have disbanded mid-event: they REMAIN on the tournament's attending roster (historical record of who played), but their amateur-origin players revert to free agency instead of receiving the live-event team override. Rosters kept together are NOT listed here — their team is pinned in the amateur sheet so they persist. Eiromancers is listed because it kept only its core three (via the amateur sheet); the two who left revert to free agents.
